ws-best-end:
n = int(input())
results = input().split()
current = 0
bestLength = 0
bestStart = 0
bestEnd = 0
for index in range(n):
    if results[index] == "1":
        current = current + 1
    else:
        current = 0
    if current >= bestLength and current > 0:
        bestLength = current
        bestEnd = index + 1
        bestStart = bestEnd - current + 1
print(bestEnd)
